meta.name: setup-matt-pocock-skills
meta.description: Sets up an `## Agent skills` block in AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md and `docs/agents/` so the engineering skills know this repo's issue tracker (GitHub or local markdown), triage label vocabulary, and domain doc layout. Run before first use of `to-issues`, `to-prd`, `triage`, `diagnose`, `tdd`, `improve-codebase-architecture`, or `zoom-out` — or if those skills appear to be missing context about the issue tracker, triage labels, or domain docs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 配置工程技能所需的仓库上下文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在仓库中首次使用工程技能套件
copy.tagline_en: Configure repo context for engineering skills
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to set up issue tracker and domain doc context for engineering skills

howto.what: 这个技能会引导你设置仓库的配置，包括问题追踪器（GitHub、GitLab或本地Markdown）、分类标签词汇和领域文档位置。完成后，其他工程技能就能正确读取和写入问题、应用标签、查找上下文。
howto.when: 在首次使用 `to-issues`、`triage`、`tdd` 等工程技能之前，或者当这些技能缺少问题追踪器、标签或领域文档上下文时触发。

say.text: 帮我设置这个仓库的工程技能配置。
say.note: 技能会开始探索仓库并引导你完成设置。

say.text: 我想把问题追踪器改成本地Markdown。
say.note: 技能会更新配置，让其他技能使用本地文件作为问题追踪器。

say.text: 检查一下当前的问题追踪器和标签配置。
say.note: 技能会展示当前配置并询问是否需要修改。

howto.what_en: This skill guides you through setting up repository configuration, including issue tracker (GitHub, GitLab, or local markdown), triage label vocabulary, and domain doc locations. After setup, other engineering skills can correctly read/write issues, apply labels, and find context.
howto.when_en: Trigger before first use of skills like `to-issues`, `triage`, `tdd`, or when those skills appear to be missing context about the issue tracker, triage labels, or domain docs.

say_en.text: Help me set up the engineering skills configuration for this repo.
say_en.note: The skill will explore the repo and guide you through setup.

say_en.text: I want to change the issue tracker to local markdown.
say_en.note: The skill will update config so other skills use local files for issues.

say_en.text: Check the current issue tracker and label configuration.
say_en.note: The skill will show current config and ask if changes are needed.
